title: Increase Vertical Spacing (AlignAndSize)

scenarios.title: Increase Vertical Spacing applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Increase Vertical Spacing (BtnIncreaseVerticalSpacing) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.expected: The +10 increment leaves the top-most shape anchored and grows the two vertical gaps from 50 and 60 to 60 and 70; the Left values and the source geometry stay untouched and the matching decrement restores the original layout exactly.
